games.name: [RELEASE] Prehistoric Farm
games.desc:
🦖 Welcome to Prehistoric Farm 🦖

Dig up the past and bring it back to life! Sail across wild islands, unearth ancient fossils, and turn them into eggs at Dr. Ivy's DNA Lab. Hatch your very own dinosaurs, raise them from tiny Newborns into huge Elders, and ride them across your ranch!

[How To Play]
▪ Grab your shovel and hold down on a dig site. Let go when the meter is in the green for a better find!
▪ Collect a full set of fossils and bring them to Dr. Ivy to grow an egg
▪ Warm your egg in the incubator and watch it hatch
▪ Keep your dino's belly over half full so it keeps growing
▪ Once it's grown, hop on and ride your partner dino around the islands!

[Explore]
▪ Buy bigger boats and sail to new fossil islands
▪ Fish the open sea and dive for rare catches
▪ Sneak into the Sunken Grotto to steal sea reptile eggs
▪ Team up with other players to take down the giant Mosasaurus with spears!

Works on PC, mobile and console.

games.name: Examination
games.desc:
!! This game is a heavy WIP and just a passion project, so expect bugs and non-final content. !!
"You are going nowhere but to hell... I hope you like it there."

Examination is a PvE horror shooter, where you're tasked to clear a highly irradiated nuclear power plant that's turned into a laboratory in the wake of the WE-30 outbreak, a nation-spanning infection that, while not indiscriminate, has swallowed select zones and regions whole, reducing them to heavily quarantined White-Zones. 
You're one of the later waves sent to the facility. What fate has befallen to the earlier waves is unknown. Don't become one of them.

Things to note:
7+ graphics are recommended.
Best played on a private server
The controls are laid out on the screen at the class lockers
The game is challenging and you are expected to falter in the beginning, don't give up!

Rules & Credits - https://devforum.roblox.com/t/examination-rules-credits/3809900
